column1: # helpers.tsv — the creators that get a double-click helper, and the types
# each helper's bundle claims: its icons, and what it hands on to MacExtract,
# with the types MacExtract's own bundle claims; any other type goes to the
# creator's own application (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-31, *the stub that sorts*;
# 2026-11-13, *the icon types only the helper claims*).
#   creator   the helper's creator, MacStamp's evidence for it in `source`
#   name      the helper's file name: 8 characters at most, since on Mac
#             OS 9 a longer one loses the creator to StuffIt Expander at the
#   program   the program that owns it (app-bundles.tsv, or MacStamp's
#   types     comma-separated, since a type may end in a space; each one
#             a type MacExtract opens, and MacExtract's bundle claims it,
#             except DiskDoubler's 40 icon types, which only the DDAP
#   source    pair = MacStamp's own pair for the format (data/formats.tsv);
